DEN_undermine_overlord_continuous_focus.description: We must do what we can to resist and undermine our Overlords to ensure Danish sovereignty.
DEN_undermine_overlord_continuous_focus.title: Undermine Overlord Influence

ETH_strengthen_the_black_lions.description: Although we have lost land to the enemy, the fight must go on. The Black Lions are offering a great deal of resistance to the Italian’s and we should therefore support them anyway we can.
ETH_strengthen_the_black_lions.title: Strengthen the Black Lions

ETH_supporting_the_arbegnoch.description: Across [ROOT.GetName] there are patriots willing to take up arms against the [ITA.GetAdjective] invaders. We must do everything we can to support these brave men and women in crippling the [ITA.GetAdjective] war machine.
ETH_supporting_the_arbegnoch.title: Supporting the Arbegnoch

SWI_build_up_military_readiness.description: The task of preparing the Swiss population is never-ending. We cannot rest until the threat of invasion is gone, and it might never be. We must orient our nation towards defensive preparations without delay.
SWI_build_up_military_readiness.title: Build up Military Readiness

SWI_support_active_militias_continuous_f.description: Our citizens are armed and deployed into their local militias, it is everyone else's duty to support them however they can so we can keep the enemies of the confederation at bay
SWI_support_active_militias_continuous_f.title: Support Active Militias

THR_abbot_examiners.description: Let senior teachers test every public mission before it leaves the mountains, turning governance into clearer doctrine abroad.
THR_abbot_examiners.title: Abbot Examiners

THR_absorb_the_shadow.description: Under extreme chaos, the Realm can fold the false claim into its own doctrine. The power is real, and so is the corruption.
THR_absorb_the_shadow.title: Absorb the Shadow

THR_all_roads_end_silence.description: Survey sacred roads, close remote sites, and let foreign observers guess at the purpose.
THR_all_roads_end_silence.title: Seal the Remote Roads

THR_arhat_examinations.description: Select officials who claim detachment from fear, faction, and personal gain.
THR_arhat_examinations.title: Arhat Examinations

THR_arhats_take_office.description: Create the Arhat Administration and give oath-bound officials authority over the Realm's daily needs.
THR_arhats_take_office.title: The Arhats Take Office

THR_bodhisattva_accepts_seal.description: Transform the refuge into a Bodhisattva-led state.
THR_bodhisattva_accepts_seal.title: The Bodhisattva Accepts the Seal

THR_break_false_mandala.description: The Realm's officials and guards dismantle the rival shrine. Defilements rise, and its monasteries lose their freedom to oppose the Buddha.
THR_break_false_mandala.title: Break the False Mandala

THR_buddha_mandate.description: The Bodhisattva can become Buddha with §Y108§! Bodhi, §YFourth Dhyana§!, Defilements below §Y20§!, twelve successful teachings, and one teaching success during a major chaos crisis.
THR_buddha_mandate.title: The Unshaken Seat

THR_compassion_of_non_return.description: Define mercy as the prevention of every possible return.
THR_compassion_of_non_return.title: Compassion of Non-Return

THR_complete_himalayan_mandala.description: War and disorder threaten the mountain roads. The Realm may authorize force against the courts that remain outside its protection.
THR_complete_himalayan_mandala.title: Secure the High Passes

THR_convene_mountain_assembly.description: Give the refuge a chamber before the chamber becomes a ministry. The assembly unlocks Dharma Teaching decisions, advances the Bodhisattva bhumi, grants major Political Power, and slightly reduces Chaos.
THR_convene_mountain_assembly.title: Convene Mountain Assembly

THR_council_of_abbots.description: Let senior abbots bind doctrine, teaching, and refuge law before the Arhat offices harden around them.
THR_council_of_abbots.title: Council of Abbots

THR_count_mountain_roads.description: Map the roads used by grain, pilgrims, troops, and refugees. Each controlled state gains major infrastructure and a listening post, while the Realm gains Political Power and Mandala Reach.
THR_count_mountain_roads.title: Pilgrimage Roads

THR_debate_the_pretender_focus.description: The pretender is brought before abbots, refugees, soldiers, and witnesses. The Realm answers the counterfeit mandala through teaching.
THR_debate_the_pretender_focus.title: Debate the Pretender

THR_doctrine_last_war.description: Open the final ritual path only after Buddhahood and the first awakened power display. This does not authorize Final Silence by itself.
THR_doctrine_last_war.title: The Last Wheel

THR_eastern_chinese_registers.description: Only extreme disorder draws the Realm into eastern China. War aims open against the region, but each state must still be taken and integrated.
THR_eastern_chinese_registers.title: Eastern China in Crisis

THR_eastern_mandala.description: Extend the Mandala toward western China. Greater influence abroad gives the Realm a path into Chinese affairs.
THR_eastern_mandala.title: The Eastern Pilgrimage Mandala

THR_empty_seat.description: Stabilize the Empty Seat aftermath in which the Buddha has passed beyond worldly action and the Realm remains to guard the wheel.
THR_empty_seat.title: The Empty Seat

THR_exile_the_echo.description: The false circle can be broken without blood by pushing its teachers beyond the passes. The danger leaves the capital and remains abroad.
THR_exile_the_echo.title: Exile the Echo

THR_extinction_of_defilements_focus.description: Complete the inner rite with full Meditation Charge and end the last defilements before the final order.
THR_extinction_of_defilements_focus.title: Extinction of Defilements

THR_final_silence.description: Authorize the sealed doctrine only if every strict final condition has been met.
THR_final_silence.title: The Last Authorization

THR_first_doctrine_suffering.description: Make relief, judgement, and policy answer to the language of suffering.
THR_first_doctrine_suffering.title: The First Doctrine of Suffering

THR_first_quiet.description: The first Dhyana offers attendants a calm discipline at the Bodhisattva's side.
THR_first_quiet.title: The First Quiet

THR_four_teaching_seats.description: Open a fourth public teaching seat so envoys, translators, refugee teachers, and foreign witnesses can work without drowning each other out.
THR_four_teaching_seats.title: Four Teaching Seats

THR_fourth_quiet.description: Let the final Dhyana milestone stand as a visible gate before the Unshaken Seat.
THR_fourth_quiet.title: The Fourth Quiet

THR_guard_high_passes.description: Fortify the approaches before the lowlands push their wars upward.
THR_guard_high_passes.title: Guard the High Passes

THR_guardians_outer_passes.description: Train the border guard to hold narrow roads, carry winter supply, and defend the shelter seal beyond the first valleys. Every controlled state receives forts and infrastructure, while the Realm gains Political Power, Command Power, army experience, and Mandala Reach.
THR_guardians_outer_passes.title: Guardians of the Pilgrim Passes

THR_high_pass_states_enter_mandala.description: Bring Tibet, Bhutan, Nepal, and Kham into one pilgrimage circuit when the Realm controls each of their mountain states.
THR_high_pass_states_enter_mandala.title: High Pass Pilgrimage Oaths

THR_labs_snow_line.description: Tie high-altitude research to the doctrine of prevention. The snow-line laboratories add three research slots and a large nuclear research program.
THR_labs_snow_line.title: Laboratories at the Snow Line

THR_lamps_entered_register.description: Lamps burn along the mountain roads through the night. Arhat guards watch the valleys as the world beyond the passes falls silent.
THR_lamps_entered_register.title: The Lamps Along the Road

THR_lamps_remain_lit.description: Choose restraint during ordinary peace. A sharp rise in global chaos closes this hopeful path.
THR_lamps_remain_lit.title: The Lamps Remain Lit

THR_last_border_is_wound.description: Treat every uncontrolled frontier as evidence that suffering remains unadministered. The Realm gains political power, war support, Final Silence Pressure, and coercive chaos.
THR_last_border_is_wound.title: The Last Border Is a Wound

THR_last_human_signature.description: Remove the final personal countersignature from doctrine.
THR_last_human_signature.title: The Last Human Signature

THR_letters_beyond_passes.description: Open the pilgrimage route and send protection letters to nearby courts. If they refuse, the Arhats may seek a darker path through the pass.
THR_letters_beyond_passes.title: Letters beyond the Passes

THR_letters_to_war_tired.description: Write to governments whose people have forgotten why the war continues.
THR_letters_to_war_tired.title: Letters to the War-Tired

THR_lotus_bridge_focus.description: Make impossible relief routes serve the Sangha Compact, threatened allies, and crisis corridors.
THR_lotus_bridge_focus.title: Lotus Bridge

THR_mandala_borders.description: The Mandala Bureau pressures nearby courts with relief, pilgrim roads, foreign observers, and limited protection claims.
THR_mandala_borders.title: Border Courts of Mercy

THR_mandala_bureau.description: Build the administrative center that turns refuge work into state capacity.
THR_mandala_bureau.title: The Mandala Bureau

THR_mandala_of_nations.description: Offer a coalition of refusal, mediation, and witnessed peace. Members take a peace vow, cannot declare offensive wars, and pursue acts of kindness that lower global chaos.
THR_mandala_of_nations.title: Mandala of Nations

THR_mandala_receives_borderlands.description: Expand the letters to nearby borderlands and prepare staged protection for states that enter by vow, occupation, or Arhat administration.
THR_mandala_receives_borderlands.title: Borderlands Petition the Mandala

THR_many_lamps_one_flame.description: Bind the teaching route to proven missions: twelve successful teachings, with at least one success during major chaos.
THR_many_lamps_one_flame.title: Many Lamps, One Flame

THR_ministry_of_release.description: Give the final doctrine an office and force the authorization chamber to decide whether it can still be refused. The ministry expands nuclear facilities, prepares a limited thermonuclear payload set if the technology exists, and opens the authorization event.
THR_ministry_of_release.title: Ministry of Silence

THR_ministry_of_vows.description: The Ministry of Vows binds every pledge and public duty to the Last Wheel.
THR_ministry_of_vows.title: Ministry of Vows

THR_monastic_labor_vows.description: Bind construction, repair, and relief work to monastic labor vows. Controlled states receive civilian workshops and infrastructure.
THR_monastic_labor_vows.title: Monastery Workshops

THR_mountain_artillery_mandalas.description: Issue artillery and rifle discipline to the guardians who hold the passes, with doctrine written around refusal and defense.
THR_mountain_artillery_mandalas.title: The Bell and Rifle

THR_mountain_granaries.description: Build high-valley granaries and a supply hub so refugee roads, winter shelters, and defensive detachments can endure pressure.
THR_mountain_granaries.title: Mountain Granaries

THR_mountain_refuge.description: Turn the high valleys into a defensible refuge with roads, stores, and legal shelter seals.
THR_mountain_refuge.title: Mountain Refuge

THR_name_protector_regent.description: Give the refuge a wartime guardian who can command roads and garrisons while the seat remains under vow.
THR_name_protector_regent.title: Name a Protector Regent

THR_no_more_peace_delegations.description: Foreign envoys may still arrive. The Realm no longer accepts ordinary pleas as policy.
THR_no_more_peace_delegations.title: No More Peace Delegations

THR_no_one_leaves_mandala.description: Close the moral circle around every road, border, and launch cell. The Realm expands its reactor network, receives nuclear research acceleration, and raises Final Silence Pressure.
THR_no_one_leaves_mandala.title: No One Leaves the Mandala

THR_no_victory_parades.description: Pacification cannot be permitted to become conquest in ceremonial dress. The Realm gains political power and command authority while lowering Final Silence Pressure and chaos.
THR_no_victory_parades.title: No Victory Parades

THR_northern_indian_register.description: The Realm claims the northern Indian valleys and gives the Arhats authority to protect them.
THR_northern_indian_register.title: Northern Indian Frontier

THR_northern_indian_state_registers.description: Northern Indian states can enter the Mandala after the Realm takes control. Full integration requires a costly decision for each state.
THR_northern_indian_state_registers.title: Northern Indian Petition Courts

THR_one_becomes_many_focus.description: Turn simultaneous teaching presence into a planned anti-chaos doctrine, expanding relief and mission coordination after the power is shown.
THR_one_becomes_many_focus.title: One Becomes Many

THR_outer_valleys_register.description: Send Arhats into held valleys to judge local loyalty, guard storehouses, and restore order before resistance grows into war.
THR_outer_valleys_register.title: Outer Valley Courts

THR_pacification_mandate.description: Treat force as the sharp instrument of mercy.
THR_pacification_mandate.title: Pacification Mandate

THR_pacification_without_triumph.description: If force is used, it must not become a parade. The focus unlocks pacification tools, adds the Pacification without Triumph idea, grants major Command Power and army experience, and raises Compassion Drift and Chaos.
THR_pacification_without_triumph.title: Pacification without Triumph

THR_path_through_walls.description: Prepare the Realm to cross walls, passes, rivers, and broken front lines only where chaos has made ordinary roads meaningless.
THR_path_through_walls.title: Path through Walls

THR_peace_by_submission.description: Make the letters more persuasive when the Realm is stronger. Entry without war can ease Chaos, but coercive authority strains the vow.
THR_peace_by_submission.title: Protection by Petition

THR_permit_foreign_pilgrimage.description: Let foreign witnesses enter the Realm under an oath of protection.
THR_permit_foreign_pilgrimage.title: Permit Foreign Pilgrimage

THR_pilgrim_refuge_courts.description: Let the Pilgrim Assembly judge appeals from unstable neighbors before the compact decides whether refuge can become obligation.
THR_pilgrim_refuge_courts.title: Pilgrim Refuge Courts

THR_powers_are_not_toys.description: Discipline the awakened powers so they remain instruments against chaos, not another language for ordinary war.
THR_powers_are_not_toys.title: Powers Are Not Toys

THR_question_false_attainment_focus.description: Test whether Arhat office credentials still carry a burden.
THR_question_false_attainment_focus.title: The Question of False Attainment

THR_quiet_envoys.description: Send letters and relief missions before the mandate becomes an ultimatum.
THR_quiet_envoys.title: Quiet Envoys

THR_quiet_mobilization.description: Raise reserve detachments for road watches, avalanche lines, and narrow passes without turning protection into parade mobilization.
THR_quiet_mobilization.title: Mountain Pass Detachments

THR_reactors_prayer_wheels.description: Bind nuclear and thermonuclear research to the final doctrine. The focus builds reactors and a nuclear facility, then grants major nuclear research bonuses. The arsenal must still be produced.
THR_reactors_prayer_wheels.title: Reactors and Prayer Wheels

THR_read_pattern_suffering.description: The Bodhisattva compares what the students have learned, what the armies have seen, and what the awakened eye reveals about suffering.
THR_read_pattern_suffering.title: Read the Pattern of Suffering

THR_refuge_foundries.description: Arm the passes without admitting that the refuge has become a fortress. Every controlled state receives new military and civilian industry.
THR_refuge_foundries.title: Refuge Foundries

THR_refusal_of_empires.description: Reject imperial claims over suffering outside the mountains.
THR_refusal_of_empires.title: Refusal of Empires

THR_refuse_final_debate.description: Refuse to let apocalypse become a legitimate subject of policy.
THR_refuse_final_debate.title: Refuse Final Debate

THR_regent_pass_watch.description: Place the Protector Regent's officers at the roads where panic, supplies, and anti-chaos defense meet.
THR_regent_pass_watch.title: Regent's Pass Watch

THR_release_through_administration.description: Pacify territory through Arhat rule, relief, and imposed order. No celebration follows the rite.
THR_release_through_administration.title: Release Through Administration

THR_return_to_the_seat.description: Keep the fourth Dhyana alive after awakening, so practice continues to renew the Buddha's powers.
THR_return_to_the_seat.title: Return to the Seat

THR_rewrite_civil_register.description: Replace emergency rule with courts that assign rights and duties. Core lands gain infrastructure and civil industry, while administered non-core lands gain compliance and lower resistance.
THR_rewrite_civil_register.title: Reform Civil Administration

THR_roads_must_be_quiet.description: Roads that carry grain, refugees, envoys, and patrols must stop carrying rumor. The focus unlocks border-control decisions, adds the Border Quiet idea, and grants Political Power, Command Power, Mandala Reach, and Compassion Drift.
THR_roads_must_be_quiet.title: Safe Roads for Pilgrims

THR_seal_of_refuge.description: Turn shelter seals into state law. Protected communities provide manpower, stability, infrastructure, civil industry, Spiritual Legitimacy, Mandala Reach, and a small Chaos reduction.
THR_seal_of_refuge.title: The Seal of Refuge

THR_seal_roads_from_panic.description: Keep safe roads open through the valleys while Arhat guards guide families away from panicked armies.
THR_seal_roads_from_panic.title: Seal the Roads from Panic

THR_seat_pilgrim_assembly.description: Let pilgrims, guides, and witnesses hold a chamber that keeps foreign teaching and compact work close to the state.
THR_seat_pilgrim_assembly.title: Seat the Pilgrim Assembly

THR_seated_in_sky_focus.description: Prepare the emergency sky-seated display for capitals and sanctuaries threatened by chaos, never as an ordinary invasion tool.
THR_seated_in_sky_focus.title: Seated in the Sky

THR_second_quiet.description: Carry the second Dhyana through the offices and the roads that feed them.
THR_second_quiet.title: The Second Quiet

THR_second_refuge.description: Turn renunciation into a new shelter system for those fleeing the wider collapse.
THR_second_refuge.title: The Second Refuge

THR_send_first_envoys.description: Send teachers and interpreters beyond the mountain roads. Dharma Teaching decisions become a public arm of the Realm.
THR_send_first_envoys.title: Send the First Envoys

THR_sermon_without_translation.description: Issue doctrine that foreign ministries cannot render into normal state language.
THR_sermon_without_translation.title: A Sermon without Translation

THR_shelter_border_villages.description: Accept the villages nearest the passes into the refuge system.
THR_shelter_border_villages.title: Shelter the Border Villages

THR_shelter_exiles.description: Give foreign exiles a legal place beneath the seal. Exile communities provide manpower, civil construction in every controlled state, Political Power, Spiritual Legitimacy, and a small Chaos reduction.
THR_shelter_exiles.title: Shelter the Exiles

THR_shelters_under_stone.description: Prepare bunkers, anti-air, and winter shelters to protect lives under a defensive vow.
THR_shelters_under_stone.title: Fortress Without Hatred

THR_show_the_powers.description: Reveal the Buddha's first awakened power against a true chaos enemy. The world sees that the Awakened One has not yet reached release.
THR_show_the_powers.title: Show the Powers

THR_silent_offices.description: Build offices that process petitions without political theatre.
THR_silent_offices.title: Silent Offices

THR_sit_beneath_prayer_flags.description: Give the concentration vows a public place in the focus route. The Realm begins turning meditation from private practice into a state requirement.
THR_sit_beneath_prayer_flags.title: Sit Beneath Prayer Flags

THR_snowline_clinics.description: Turn support stores and mountain clinics toward field relief, stability, and compassion, with no ordinary militarization.
THR_snowline_clinics.title: Snowline Clinics

THR_sort_worthy_broken.description: The refugee lines continue as the Arhats separate useful labor, protected families, and cases the Realm says cannot be saved by open shelter alone.
THR_sort_worthy_broken.title: Sort the Worthy from the Broken

THR_storehouses_for_world.description: Open the sanctuary logistics system to compact relief and threatened roads beyond the Realm.
THR_storehouses_for_world.title: Storehouses for the World

THR_teach_under_bombardment.description: Keep the teaching route open while chaos, world-end pressure, or a chaos war makes every sermon a crisis act.
THR_teach_under_bombardment.title: Teach under Bombardment

THR_the_awakened_one.description: Let the Realm arrange its offices around the Buddha who no longer fits the shape of a ruler.
THR_the_awakened_one.title: The Awakened One

THR_third_quiet.description: Require every bureau near the seat to reckon with the stillness it claims to serve.
THR_third_quiet.title: The Third Quiet

THR_throne_without_body.description: Let doctrine govern beyond any single human hesitation.
THR_throne_without_body.title: The Throne Without a Body

THR_touch_sun_moon_focus.description: Keep the strongest public sign for a world-collapse crisis or a proven awakened display against chaos.
THR_touch_sun_moon_focus.title: Touch the Sun and Moon

THR_translation_houses.description: Build houses where vows, petitions, and foreign reports can be carried between languages without becoming ordinary propaganda.
THR_translation_houses.title: Translation Houses

THR_unbroken_pass.description: Bind shelters, detachments, and guardian fire into a last-pass defense against chaos pressure.
THR_unbroken_pass.title: The Unbroken Pass

THR_vanishing_from_sight_focus.description: Train relief columns to move unseen among chaos enemies, leaving ordinary countries beyond the power's reach.
THR_vanishing_from_sight_focus.title: Vanishing from Sight

THR_village_without_petitions.description: Review the first district where silence may mean peace or fear.
THR_village_without_petitions.title: A Village without Petitions

THR_vow_against_annihilation.description: Bind the Mandate against world-ending doctrine.
THR_vow_against_annihilation.title: Vow Against Annihilation

THR_vow_keeper_regiments.description: Organize troops whose oaths bind them to protection before conquest. The focus creates an elite Vow-Keeper Mountaineer template, spawns six equipped mountain divisions, and adds major manpower, army experience, and doctrine discounts.
THR_vow_keeper_regiments.title: Vow-Keeper Regiments

THR_western_chinese_registers.description: The Realm extends protection claims into Sichuan, Qinghai, Gansu, Yunnan, Ningxia, Suiyuan, Shaanbei, and Urumqi.
THR_western_chinese_registers.title: Western Chinese Frontier

THR_white_flags_foreign_roads.description: Send peacekeepers and relief columns where state failure keeps the wheel turning.
THR_white_flags_foreign_roads.title: White Flags on Foreign Roads

THR_witnesses_gather.description: Ask taught countries and Mandala members to stand with the Realm as it approaches its final doctrine.
THR_witnesses_gather.title: Witnesses Gather

THR_witnesses_keep_the_record.description: Ask taught countries, compact members, and Mandala offices to preserve what remained after Final Silence.
THR_witnesses_keep_the_record.title: Witnesses Guard the Memory

THR_world_is_a_border.description: Only under extreme chaos does the Realm ask larger frontiers to submit. This is imperial Mandala logic. Final Silence is a separate nuclear doctrine.
THR_world_is_a_border.title: The World Is Asked to Kneel

THR_world_marked_as_wound_focus.description: The Realm sees foreign suffering as one wound. Its envoys carry this teaching abroad while the Arhats prepare a harsher answer to war.
THR_world_marked_as_wound_focus.title: The World Is Marked as a Wound

THR_world_still_burns.description: Continue aid and mediation without claiming the world can be solved.
THR_world_still_burns.title: The World Still Burns

continuous_air_production.description: We can reorganize our aviation industry to eliminate waste and streamline production.
continuous_air_production.title: Air Production

continuous_boost_freedom.description: By reorganizing our colonial bureaucracy and recruiting native administrators, we will, in time, be able to take charge of our own affairs.
continuous_boost_freedom.title: Increase Autonomy

continuous_naval_production.description: By focusing resources on our shipyards and exempting skilled shipbuilders from military service, we can dramatically reduce production time for ships.
continuous_naval_production.title: Naval Production

continuous_non_factory_construct.description: There is still a lot of slack in our construction industry. By focusing our attention on it, we can achieve a significant improvement in construction speed. Unfortunately, the production of machine tools has proven a major bottleneck in the expansion of our heavy industry, so they won't benefit from efforts in this area.
continuous_non_factory_construct.title: Construction Engineering
